meta.title: Yororis: a listening space with a face and a voice
meta.description: Yororis is a listening space with a face and a voice. Under construction: built in the open, its framework studied before anything is offered. Nothing is live, and there is no date.

hero.title: A listening space with a face and a voice.
hero.lead: Some evenings you need to put words on what you carry. Yororis gives you a presence, an AI that says it is one, that listens, asks one question, and stops.

reviewed.construction: We're building Yororis in the open and studying its framework — legal, ethical, clinical — before making it available. Nothing is live, nothing is offered, and there is no date.
isNot: Not care: Yororis makes no health claim and replaces no one who supports you.
Not an emergency service: in a crisis, people trained to listen answer right away.
Not a person: an AI presence that says so, every time.
reviewed.isNotRule: Not care, not an emergency service, not a person. In a crisis in Canada, call or text 9-8-8 — in Québec, 811 (Info-Social).

what.title: A presence that listens, and stops
what.statusNote: None of these four steps is available yet. This is what we are building, in order.

steps.title: You arrive
steps.text: Your organisation invites you. You read a short statement, confirm your age and choose your language.

steps.title: The presence introduces itself
steps.text: It says it is an AI, with a permanent “AI” mark on its portrait. You give your mood yourself, from 1 to 5.

steps.title: You talk, it listens
steps.text: It listens, reflects back and asks one question at a time. The time left is always on screen.

steps.title: It stops, you keep a summary
steps.text: At the end of the moment the transcript is gone. A short summary remains, yours to read, edit or delete.

what.lead: A person opens a moment with a presence: an AI with a first name, an animated portrait carrying a permanent “AI” mark, a voice and exact subtitles. It is meant for organisations first, a wellbeing programme, a professional order, an employer, which set the limits for their members.

how.title: How we're building it
how.lead: The repositories are public, the framework is written down, and the code refuses to go further than the study. Nothing here is a promise of availability.

guards.title: The guardrails
guards.lead: Yororis has no AI provider of its own: every AI call goes through the wellbeing pack of its engine, Orazaka. The guards live in the engine, not in a prompt.
items: Consent to a versioned statement, blocking: no consent, no moment (`451`)
A crisis guard that runs first and cannot be switched off: a fixed, reviewed answer and a sourced regional line, never generated
A scope guard: what is outside a listening space is declined, word for word
An age attestation, recorded; not available to minors
Short retention (30 days, shorter on request), encryption and an append-only audit
Installed only where a verified crisis resource exists

own.title: What Yororis adds
items: Limits applied by the server, not by the screen
The transcript destroyed when the summary is made
A mood you give yourself, 1 to 5, nothing inferred, no score
Export and deletion by the person; aggregate statistics only
Construction mode, checked by CI: no deployment, no sign-up, no production variable

open.title: Read it, check it
open.lead: Everything above is written in public.

study.title: What we are studying
study.lead: Questions, not conclusions, answered with a lawyer before anything is offered to anyone.
items: Québec: the reserved title and act, and Law 25, privacy impact, consent, retention, hosting
Canada: Health Canada's rules for software, federal privacy law, and what may be said to organisations
France and the European Union: the AI Act (telling people they talk to an AI, reading emotions), GDPR article 9
Belgium: the same European questions, and the crisis lines of both language communities
Everywhere: the conditions of a pilot with outside people, and insurance

not.title: What Yororis is not
not.lead: Said once, plainly, so that nobody has to guess.

stops.title: A presence that stops
stops.lead: The limits are not a technical constraint: they are the product. Set by the organisation that offers Yororis, applied by the server, shown on screen.

decisions.chose: Up to 25 minutes, one moment a day, three a week, defaults an organisation can lower
decisions.refused: A presence available around the clock
decisions.because: Endless availability is what makes these apps hard to put down, and the evening still ends. A moment with an end sends you back to your life and your people.
decisions.cost: Some evenings you will want more and won't get it. “That's all for today, see you tomorrow from 9 am.”

decisions.chose: A presence that says it is an AI, every moment, with a permanent “AI” mark on a clearly synthetic portrait
decisions.refused: A face that could pass for a person
decisions.because: Presence comes from timing, voice and attention, not from fooling anyone. Europe's AI Act asks for it; honesty asks for it everywhere.
decisions.cost: Less of an illusion. That is the point.

decisions.chose: A mood you give yourself, 1 to 5, before and after
decisions.refused: Reading feelings from your voice or your words
decisions.because: No model decides how you feel, and nothing is computed about you. It is more honest, and it keeps Yororis clear of reading emotions.
decisions.cost: No automatic chart of your evenings, only what you said.

decisions.chose: No nudge to return, no daily counter, no extra moment for sale
decisions.because: A listening space that wants you back is not listening.
decisions.cost: Growth we will have to earn another way: through organisations, not attention.

privacy.title: What is kept, for how long, who reads it
privacy.lead: Short answers, taken from the guardrails already written and reviewed.

items.a: A short summary of each moment, yours to read, edit or delete. The transcript is destroyed when the summary is made.
Retention is short: 30 days, shorter on request. Everything is encrypted and every access is recorded.
You. The organisation that offers Yororis sees aggregate statistics only, never what anyone says or keeps.

cta.title: Talk to us about Yororis
cta.body: An organisation with a wellbeing programme, a professional who wants to read the framework, a developer who wants to build it with us: write to us. While Yororis is under construction, that is the one door open.
